research_notes: Blocked: private employer and broad job dates established, but full-time hours and precise interval endpoints not found in official, party, public-post or targeted full-time searches using both search engines.
Woolworths pastry and shop-assistant entries overlap and must be merged if later counted. Nearly fifteen years of association with employer is not fifteen documented full-time years.
Need employment confirmation showing casual/part-time/full-time transitions and start/end dates. Tutor volunteering is excluded; missing public history remains unknown.

Follow-up2026-10-02: named AMES Noble Park as volunteering host; primary employer journal confirms SDA Victoria role; contemporary ABC expressly establishes full-time organiser. Part-time retail while studying is evidenced, but no calendar bounds for that status or later changes.

First-speech account broadens worksite history beyond Dandenong Plaza and adds delegate/HSR responsibilities. Study qualifications are not paid teaching. An AMES article about chief of staff Hafiz and his full-time employment concerns another person and is excluded.

Follow-up2026-10-03: targeted searches for Woolworths contract status, pastry apprenticeship/training, store transitions, exact SDA commencement and education-support employment returned only the already recorded broad biographies and Summer2017 organiser observation. A2025 ABC profile restates baking/shelf work and qualifications but supplies no employment boundaries or hours. No retail full-time interval was inferred.

Next leads: Woolworths work-history confirmation with store and contract changes, dated training/apprenticeship records, exact SDA appointment/cessation and AMES volunteer dates. Private FT headline stays null because excluded union FT evidence cannot be transferred to retail.

Follow-up2026-10-04: targeted pastry-apprenticeship, qualification and Woolworths-training searches found the current official profile's Cert III Commercial Cookery (Box Hill TAFE), Cert IV Patisserie and Diploma of Hospitality Management (William Angliss), alongside the already recorded 2002–2017 shop-assistant and 2008–2017 pastry-chef labels. The qualifications do not establish an apprenticeship employer, training dates, paid study, contract type or full-time hours. Exact retail status transitions, store movements, SDA appointment/cessation and AMES volunteer dates remain unresolved; no headline interval was inferred.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Added four omitted qualifications and three party committee offices. Institution biography corroborates Angliss graduation; AMES interview explains teaching-aide course followed hospitality study. Tourism, travel-business and chef careers of other panel members rejected; twenty-year union involvement not converted to paid organiser tenure. Official, university and exact-name full-time searches still supply no retail contract transitions, store dates or apprenticeship pay/leave evidence. Next Woolworths contract changes and institution course dates; unknowns retained.

Fifth follow-up 5 October 2026: targeted Woolworths pastry/apprenticeship, individual full-time status and AMES volunteer searches across both engines returned known teenage retail and later union biographies, without personal training contract, paid fraction, leave or store-movement dates. Current Woolworths trade-baker/apprentice advertisements and generic three-year training requirements do not establish her historic apprenticeship or full-time status. Refugee programme and trolley-contract compliance records concern other workers; not transferred to her. Existing early part-time study/work evidence remains explicit, later hours unknown and nested pastry/retail spells nonadditive. Next useful evidence is an original individual contract/status change record or institution-dated course/placement history, not generic biography. No numerical or research-status change.

Second targeted primary pass 5 October 2026: searched Box Hill institutional records and William Angliss apprenticeship/alumna records as distinct leads from general political biographies. William Angliss Institute Annual Report2023, community/student-engagement section (https://www.angliss.edu.au/siteassets/pdf-files/publications/2023-william-angliss-annual-report.pdf), describes Fernando as an alumna speaking at International Womens Day2023; it supplies no personal enrolment, graduation, apprenticeship-contract dates or historic Woolworths hours. Apprenticeship-delegation records name her as a parliamentary representative, not an apprentice. Current SDA journal Senior Organiser/Womens Officer/President2021 text describes Julie Davis, not Fernando; no transfer of adjacent biography. Known2017–2022 full-time union organising remains excluded and cannot establish full-time retail. No new tenure or total; next individual historic training/retail contract and dated organiser appointment/cessation evidence.
